name: k8s events dead-man — no Warning events for 3 h
description: Fires when ZERO rows reach the k8s-events dataset in the trailing 180 min (evaluated hourly). The poweredge-xubuntu collector's k8sobjects/events receiver watches Kubernetes Warning events, and that watch can die while the rest of the collector keeps emitting, so k8s-cluster-state-silent does not cover it; it did on 2026-11-06 when the API server stopped serving, and stayed dead five days. WINDOW: measured Warning volume 2026-11-01..06 was 1..4436/h with many single-event hours, so 20 min would fire on a quiet cluster. UNGROUPED, because a grouped query cannot fire on a silent subject. Runbook: on poweredge-xubuntu, journalctl -u otel-collector | grep -E 'k8sobjects|retrywatcher'; restart with just ansible-apply ansible/restart-otel-collector.yml -e otel_collector_restart_confirm=poweredge-xubuntu. Item livespec-dev-tooling-a4rd4f.
